memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Sciatica
  - Status: pain 3/10, intermittent, straight leg raise negative.
  - Plan: continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD; arrange physiotherapy.
- Gout
  - Status: no acute flare, serum uric acid pending.
  - Plan: start allopurinol 100 mg OD; monitor uric acid.
- Weight: 80 kg, waist circumference 94 cm (above male cutoff 90 cm).
- Diet advice:
  - Breakfast: whole grain toast with egg white, no added sugar.
  - Lunch: vegetable dal, brown rice, limited oil.
  - Dinner: grilled fish, steamed vegetables, small portion roti.
- Due: HbA1c repeat on 2025-07-05.
